proves.claim: boardLinkPorts returns an authority and a capability whose binding is the JSON of the link record body.

cli.io-link-ports.capability-binds-the-r.why: Without it the verify path could seal a delivery under a capability bound to some other link.

proves.claim: A board with no signer file, or a readKey that returns nothing, refuses BOARD_LINK_AUTH and the message names pullboard link.

cli.io-link-ports.missing-signer-or-key-.why: Without it a missing signer or key would surface later as an unexplained delivery failure.
